function.name: archive_documents
function.description: Archives a list of documents based on document IDs and an optional expiration date for archival. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

document_ids.description: A list of unique identifier strings for the documents to be archived.

expire_date.description: The expiration date for the archival in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2023-12-31'. If not provided, defaults to 'null' which implies no expiration.

notify_user.description: Flag indicating whether to notify the user upon successful archival. Defaults to false.

message.content:
**Shashi Tej Reddy** is an Indian politician who has been active in national politics for several decades. He is best known for his tenure as a Union Minister in the Government of India during the late 1990s and early 2000s.

| Period | Position |
|--------|----------|
| 1998‑2004 | Minister of State (Independent Charge) for Finance |
| 1999‑2004 | Minister of State (Independent Charge) for External Affairs |
| 1999‑2004 | Minister of State (Independent Charge) for Commerce & Industry |
| 1999‑2004 | Minister of State (Independent Charge) for Parliamentary Affairs |

He represented the **Nalgonda constituency** in the Lok Sabha (the lower house of Parliament) and was a prominent member of the **Indian National Congress** party. Reddy has also served as a Member of Parliament in both the 10th and 11th Lok Sabhas.

Beyond his ministerial roles, he has been involved in various parliamentary committees and has contributed to discussions on fiscal policy, trade, and foreign relations. His career reflects a focus on economic development and international diplomacy within the framework of Indian governance.
